landing.heroTitleHighlight: take the next step with confidence.
landing.heroDescription: A self-check app to help you access emergency contraception. No registration is required, and it shows possible next steps in minutes.
landing.anonymousDesc: No personal-information registration is required. Self-check answers are processed on your device, but contact, external links, analytics, and similar features may send necessary information to external services.
landing.quickDesc: Answer simple questions to see general guidance on next steps and where to seek help.
landing.pharmacyDesc: Search the official government list by prefecture, pharmacy name, or address.
landing.pdfDesc: Create a personal note that organizes your answers and the general guidance.
landing.step1Desc: Follow the on-screen instructions and answer simple questions.
landing.step2Desc: See general guidance on next steps and where to seek help based on your answers.
landing.step3Desc: Contact a pharmacy or medical institution promptly and use your personal note if helpful.
landing.privacyDesc: No registration is required. Self-check answers are processed on your device. Contact, external links, analytics, and other external-service features may transmit necessary information.
landing.faq1A: Anyone considering emergency contraception can use this app. Pharmacy sales have no age restriction, but current practice encourages those under 16 to consult a medical institution.
landing.faq2A: No registration is required, and self-check answers are processed on your device. However, contact, external links, analytics, and similar features may send necessary information to external services. See the Privacy Policy for details.
landing.faq3Q: Where can I get emergency contraception?
landing.faq3A: Since February 2, 2026, designated pharmacies in Japan may sell emergency contraception without a prescription as a pharmacist-guided drug. The MHLW pharmacy list was updated July 1, 2026. Call before visiting to confirm stock and that a trained pharmacist is on duty; the purchaser herself takes one tablet in-store in front of the pharmacist.
landing.faq4A: This app is free. Emergency-contraception prices vary by product, pharmacy, and medical institution, so confirm the cost in advance.
landing.faq5Q: Is this app's guidance medical advice?
landing.faq5A: No. It is general, rule-based guidance based on your answers, not a diagnosis or a determination that you can purchase the medicine. Consult a doctor or pharmacist.
landing.finalCtaDesc: See general guidance on next steps and where to seek help
landing.partnerDesc: Rescue Pill is looking for corporate partners, sponsors, and NPO collaborations.
landing.disclaimer: This service is not a substitute for medical care. Please consult a healthcare professional about emergency contraception.

precheck.title: First, let us check
precheck.subtitle: Do you have any of these symptoms?
precheck.symptom1: Sudden or persistent severe abdominal pain
precheck.symptom3: Difficulty breathing or inability to breathe
precheck.symptom4: Ongoing bleeding with extreme weakness, faintness, or loss of consciousness
precheck.warning: Call 119 for potentially life-threatening symptoms. If you are unsure, contact emergency consultation #7119 where available or a medical institution.
precheck.hasSymptoms: One or more of these symptoms applies

questions.q2: What was the contraception situation? (Select all that apply)
